Palettes inspired by research vessels and oceanographic expeditions. The *ROV Jason*, *R/V Atlantis*, and *HOV Alvin* are workhorses of deep-sea science; their color schemes evoke their operational identity. This mode lets you pick one and get a copy-ready hex list for your figures.

```r
# import the palette data
ocean_palettes <- read.csv("data/oceanography-colors.csv")
head(ocean_palettes)
```

## The palettes

```{r}
#| label: load-oceanography
#| message: false
#| results: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

ocean <- read_csv("../data/oceanography-colors.csv")

swatch_html <- function(hex, cap = 8) {
  n <- length(hex)
  shown <- head(hex, cap)
  spans <- glue('<span class="mini-swatch" style="background:{shown}"></span>')
  out <- paste(spans, collapse = "")
  if (n > cap) out <- paste0(out, glue('<span class="palette-module-more">+{n - cap} more</span>'))
  out
}

gallery <- ocean |>
  arrange(palette, position) |>
  group_by(palette, display_name, description) |>
  summarise(
    n_colors = n(),
    swatches = swatch_html(hex),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(display_name)

cat(
  '<div class="palette-gallery">',
  glue_data(
    gallery,
    '<div class="palette-module">
  <h4>{display_name} <span class="palette-module-count">{n_colors} colors</span></h4>
  <p class="palette-module-desc">{description}</p>
  <div class="palette-module-swatches">{swatches}</div>
</div>'
  ),
  '</div>',
  sep = "\n"
)
```

## How to use it

1. **Pick a palette** from the dropdown below.
2. **Copy your choice** — R vector (ready for `scale_fill_manual()`) or plain hex list.
3. **Paste into your code** and scale your figures.

## Try it

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
oceanData = FileAttachment("../data/oceanography-colors.csv").csv({typed: true})
oceanPaletteMeta = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(oceanData, v => v[0].display_name, d => d.palette),
  ([palette, display_name]) => ({palette, display_name})
).sort((a, b) => a.display_name.localeCompare(b.display_name))
oceanOptions = new Map(oceanPaletteMeta.map(d => [d.display_name, d.palette]))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof oceanChoiceLabel = Inputs.select(Array.from(oceanOptions.keys()), {label: "Palette", value: "ROV Jason"})
oceanChoice = oceanOptions.get(oceanChoiceLabel)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
oceanFiltered = oceanData.filter(d => d.palette === oceanChoice).sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
oceanHexList = oceanFiltered.map(d => d.hex).join("\n")
oceanHexVector = 'c(' + oceanFiltered.map(d => `"${d.hex}"`).join(', ') + ')'
oceanHexSingleQuote = oceanFiltered.map(d => `'${d.hex}'`).join(', ')
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function oceanTextColor(hex) {
  const c = hex.replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16);
  const lum = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255;
  return lum > 0.6 ? "#241C1C" : "#FFFFFF";
}

html`<p style="color:#555;margin-bottom:.5rem;">${oceanFiltered.length ? oceanFiltered[0].description : ""}</p>
<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:1rem 0 1.5rem;">
  ${oceanFiltered.map(d => html`<div class="color-chip" style="background:${d.hex};padding:12px;min-width:120px;min-height:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;color:${oceanTextColor(d.hex)}">
    <div style="font-weight:600;">${d.hex}</div>
  </div>`)}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
oceanVectorCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy R vector (${oceanFiltered.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(oceanHexVector).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
oceanListCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy hex list (${oceanFiltered.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn swatch-copy-btn--secondary">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(oceanHexList).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.5rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">1. Ready for <code>scale_fill_manual()</code></p>
  ${oceanVectorCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block"><span class="hl-fu">c</span>(${oceanFiltered.map((d, i) => html`<span class="hl-st">"${d.hex}"</span>${i < oceanFiltered.length - 1 ? ", " : ""}`)})</pre>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.25rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">2. Or just the hex codes</p>
  ${oceanListCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block">${oceanHexList}</pre>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
oceanSingleQuoteCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy quoted hex (${oceanFiltered.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn swatch-copy-btn--secondary">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(oceanHexSingleQuote).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.25rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">3. Or as quoted strings</p>
  ${oceanSingleQuoteCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block">${oceanHexSingleQuote}</pre>
</div>`
```

## Using a palette back in R

```{r}
#| eval: false
my_pal <- c("#044f9a", "#fec44f", "#5d86c3", "#fc4e2a", "#b6c8db", "#2a394f")

ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = class)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_pal)
```
